description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - The National Policy on Health Information of Sri Lanka was granted and will be effective from 3rd of January, 2017
categorisation: This gazette content announces the implementation of "THE NATIONAL POLICY ON HEALTH INFORMATION OF SRI LANKA" which was granted Cabinet approval. It establishes a regulatory framework for health information management, defines standards for data collection and dissemination, and creates a formal policy structure for health information systems. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it establishes new policy frameworks and regulatory requirements rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
